title: Kinetic Control over CdS Nanocrystal Nucleation Using a Library of Thiocarbonates, Thiocarbamates, and Thioureas

source_inventory.title: Kinetic Control over CdS Nanocrystal Nucleation Using a Library of Thiocarbonates, Thiocarbamates, and Thioureas
source_inventory.scope: Main-only molecular precursor preparations, 17 CdS precursor frameworks, coproduct controls, optical/yield/NMR methods, negative observations and separated source interpretations.
source_conflicts: Main p.1 says16 h in refluxing acetonitrile for this general precursor family; individual1a methodp6 sayssealed70 °C overnight. Both source descriptions retained.
Main p.6 MS prints ion formula C15H14O2S+H+ alongside m/z231.05, while the named diphenyl product and elemental-analysis formula are C13H10O2S. Both retained; no source correction inferred.
Main p.6 prints2.39 ppm(s,3H) and another2.39 ppm(m,2H) in1H list. Retained as printed; no replacement shift invented.
Source 1 mmol limiting precursor conflicts with 1.27g98% crude and0.921g71% product. Do not repair scale or yield.
Scheme 1 usesCH2Cl2 for generic thiocarbamate preparation; individual2 method usesethyl acetate at0 °C.
Table 1 row3 X1=O-4-Me-Ph differs from p7 O-phenyl title/starting reagent/formula. The method-defined product is retained without deciding which identity applies to the3-coded CdS experiment.
Main p.1 general secondary-amine route says room-temperature overnight; individual6b method says70 °C16 h.
Reported15 mmol thiocarbonyl precursor and2.76 g product with49% yield do not reconcile with reportedC9H16N2S formula. Preserve source quantities rather than correcting yield.
Precursor 3 is O-p-tolyl inTable 1 but O-phenyl inindividualMethods; identity remains unresolved.
Table 1 row 3 has X1=O-4-Me-Ph, while main p.7 individual Methods title/reagent/formula define O-phenyl compound 3. No corrected identity is substituted.
limitations: Matching supporting information was not found locally. SI-only reaction variants, Figures S1–S24 and detailed spectra are unavailable.
External precursor preparations were not imported. Source-general protocols are not automatically exact figure batches.
No graph digitization, measured atomic coordinates or particle-shape reconstruction. Source figures and conceptual schemes retain distinct scopes.
